text_01: End-to-end real-time video pipeline on a ZYBO (ARM + FPGA) SoC: HDMI input through detection, tracking and distance calculation to simultaneous VGA and LED-matrix output plus UART telemetry.
text_02: HW/SW co-design flow: MATLAB for algorithm verification, OpenCV for optimization, then Vivado HLS to move the hot loops into FPGA fabric, with the ARM software built in the Xilinx SDK.
text_03: Color-range detection with object tracking and object-size-based distance estimation, designed for public-environment scenes.
text_04: Cost-effective, standalone build: the whole system runs on a single ZYBO board with no host PC, meeting the speed, accuracy and security goals together.
